notes.content:

[u][b]Aiko's Choice is available NOW![/b][/u]

If you have some questions, maybe they are already ansswered in our Developer Q&A Video - and if not, it still gives a great insight in the thoughts behind making this expansion.

[previewyoutube=MgGtYfdVL_A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Konnichiwa, everyone!

Celebrating the 5th anniversary of Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun, standalone expansion Aiko´s Choice releases December 6th 2021

The standalone expansion of the critically acclaimed RTT game Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun continues the story around the beloved group of assassins...

We are thrilled to finally announce the release date of Aiko’s Choice, the long-awaited standalone expansion for the acclaimed real-time tactics game Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun. On December 6th 2021, marking the 5th anniversary of the release of the original game, players will once again be sent to the ancient capital of Japan, Edo. There they will accompany the kunoichi adept Aiko and her deadly assassin friends to hunt down the ghosts of her past.

The new trailer sets the mood for Aiko’s Choice by summarizing the events of the main game (potential spoiler): 

[previewyoutube=GPxtAQxgpJo;full][/previewyoutube]

Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Aiko´s Choice focuses on one of the main game's protagonists: the kunoichi adept Aiko. She is a master of camouflage and distracts enemies disguised as a geisha. While Aiko was certain that she left her old life behind, her former sensei, the cunning spymaster Lady Chiyo, reappears from the shadows to challenge her. Together with her friends, a group of deadly assassins, she sets out to hunt down the ghosts of her past.

The expansion features three full-fledged main missions, set in brand-new environments, and three shorter interlude missions.

Like in the main game, you take control of a team of lethal specialists, move in the shadows and sneak past dozens of enemies. Choose your approach wisely when infiltrating hidden forest camps or lively Edo-period towns. Set traps, poison and distract your opponents – or avoid enemy contact altogether. Carefully plan your every move and come up with your own ingenious tactics to vanquish enemies and complete each of the challenging missions to uncover Aiko´s past.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579380/Shadow_Tactics_Blades_of_the_Shogun__Aikos_Choice/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40165985/9a8849bd1c169042666c0ddb9df8aa916b7e0b68.png[/img]

Features:

[list]
[*] Return to the beautiful world of Shadow Tactics set in Japan in the early Edo period.
[*] Rejoin your favorite characters for another adventure set within the story of the main game Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun.
[*] Experience a previously untold tale centered around the kunoichi adept Aiko, who has to face a vicious enemy connected to her past.
[*] Explore three full-fledged main missions, located in brand-new environments, and three shorter interlude missions.
[/list]

The expansion includes all the features of the main game:
[list]
[*] Play a team of completely different characters with their own unique skill sets.
[*] Synchronize your team's actions to strike down your enemies at once with the "Shadow Mode" feature.
[*] Choose between non-lethal or deadly stealth attacks.
[*] Find dozens of ways to take out or sneak past your opponents the way you want.
[*] Choose from three difficulty levels to match your skill.
[/list]

notes.title: Shadow Tactics Patch v2.2.10 is now available!
notes.content:
Honored Ninjas & Kunoichis,

Shadow Tactics Patch v2.2.2 (v2.2.6 für Linux) should actually have been our last patch for the game, so the whole Mimimi team can focus on the new title "Codename Kartoffel". Unfortunately, the patch had inconvenient issues for some players, mainly losing savegames when reverting to older versions.
So we tackled these issues and present to you Shadow Tactics Patch v2.2.10. We hope this fixed most of the problems.

We'd also like to invite you to our channels:

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/uytjwD8]https://discord.gg/uytjwD8[/url]

Reddit: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/MimimiReddit/]https://www.reddit.com/r/MimimiReddit/[/url]

Mailing List: [url=http://signup.mimimi.games]http://signup.mimimi.games[/url]

Kindest regards,
Your Mimimis

PS: It shouldn't be much longer until we can tell you more about our new Real Time Tactics game <3


[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Savegames won't break anymore when switching back from v2.2.x to v1.4.4
    [*]Greenscreen fix for Ubuntu
    [*]Fixed mouse cursor issues with special input devices (e.g. Microsoft Surface Pen)
    [*]Fixed Turkish loca UI text bugs
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
    [*][Windows] Purple / Pink Screen on game start appears on some systems with DirectX 10/11 graphics cards (system erroneously initialises DirectX 9 instead of DX10/11). Check here for possible solution: https://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/1697168437864531490/
    [*][Windows 10] If DPI scale is set to anything higher than 100%, the game window itself will also increase in height and length
    [*][MacOS] Steam Cloud Saves don't sync properly for quicksaves if the game is uninstalled and re-installed again
    [*][Ubuntu] Game always starts with Gamma set to 100%
    [*][Ubuntu] 3x Achievements in mission "Osaka Castle" won't unlock
[/list]

notes.title: Shadow Tactics Patch v2.2 is now available! (Full Public Rollout)
notes.content:
Dear Ninjas & Kunoichis,

we are very happy to finally release our latest [b]Shadow Tactics Patch v2.2[/b] with a significant improvement of the loading times as well as some other fixes for the game. This time for real.

A great thanks goes out to our Steam community who helped us test the patch before rolling it out to the whole wide world. We love you. Really. No, there are no DLCs coming right now.

[b]The total patch size is approximately 2 GB.[/b]

The patch will also come to GOG, unfortunately with a little delay.

We also applied the patch to the Demo (currently only updated for PC only, Mac/Linux to follow a bit later), so this may be the right time to shove Shadow Tactics in your friends' face - again.

We would also like to invite you to our Discord server, which is another way of giving us your feedback in general - and definitely the best place to be amongst the first to get any glimpse of our upcoming project Codename Kartoffel:

[url=https://discord.gg/uytjwD8]https://discord.gg/uytjwD8[/url]

We also just opened our own subreddit, not that anybody asked:

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/MimimiReddit/]https://www.reddit.com/r/MimimiReddit/[/url]

And just in case you really don't want to miss anything about Mimimi, here's the link to our exclusive mailing list:

[url=http://signup.mimimi.games]http://signup.mimimi.games[/url]

Thank you so much for all the love and support,
The Mimimis

notes.title: Shadow Tactics Patch v2.2 is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Ninjas & Kunoichis,

we are very happy to finally release our latest Shadow Tactics patch with a significant improvement of the loading times as well as some other fixes for the game.

But before pushing the patch out, we would kindly ask you for your help. [b]The patch will be available through an open beta branch, where you will be able to test it and give us your feedback directly here on Steam, so we can be sure of the quality before pushing it out full public.[/b]

For feedback on the patch, simply use [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/208684375428476403/]this thread (Link)[/url] here on Steam. We are especially looking for your feedback on your performance experience with this new version.

We would also like to invite you to our Developer Discord server, which is another way of giving us your feedback in general - and definitely the best place to be amongst the first to get any glimpse of our upcoming project:

[url=https://discord.gg/uytjwD8]https://discord.gg/uytjwD8[/url]

And just in case you really don't want to miss anything about Mimimi, here's the link to our exclusive mailing list:

[url=http://signup.mimimi.games]http://signup.mimimi.games[/url]

[b]WARNING:[/b] In case you switch to the new branch, your savegames won't work anymore, but you can switch back to the original branch at any time to get your savegames to work again. This doesn't affect your game progress, like which levels you already unlocked, it's just about the savegames. Furthermore you can download savegames for every level in the new branch.

You'll find a step by step instruction on how to switch the branches and the savegames for every level here:
[url=http://www.daedalicsupport.com/en/games/shadow-tactics/?open=collapse214-10]www.daedalicsupport.com[/url]
and here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/3377008022039876392/]Steam Forum Thread - How to switch branches[/url]

[b]The total patch size is approximately 2 GB.[/b]

Thank you so much for all the love and support,
The Mimimis

You'll find a step by step instruction on how to switch the branches and the savegames for every level here:
[url=http://www.daedalicsupport.com/en/games/shadow-tactics/?open=collapse214-10]www.daedalicsupport.com[/url]
and here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/3377008022039876392/]Steam Forum Thread - How to switch branches[/url]

[b]The total patch size is approximately 2 GB.[/b]

Thank you so much for all the love and support,
The Mimimis

notes.title: New update available (1.2.1.)!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The team listened to your suggestions and wishes and hustled back and forth to implement them to the upcoming update. Just a little reminder: the controls can be bound freely. These are the changes and additions:

[h1]Changelog (from 1.1.2. to 1.2.1):[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added new control options: 
   [*]"Invert Camera Movement"
   [*]"Invert Camera Rotation"
   [*]"Invert Camera Zoom"
   [*]"Invert Aiming"
[*]Set V-Sync default to 60 for new installs
[*]Set V-Sync in menu to 60 (independent from V-Sync setting in Video options)
[*]Set unknown gamepad default to not enabled (can be re-enabled in the options menu)
[*]Added user data backup
[*]Added key bindings for character multiselecting and camera dragging
[*]Fixed errors at game start that resulted in only showing a black screen
[*]Achievements completed in the demo should now complete correctly on Steam
[*]Eye-Tracking: SpeedUp and Fix of Bungee-Zoom
[*]Chinese localization reworked
[*]Other minor localization fixes
[/list]

[h1]Italian text localization is confirmed![/h1]

On a positive side note we are happy to let you know that we can now confirm that Italian text localization will be added to the game in early 2017. A local boxed edition will also become available which is being published and distributed by our partner Adventure Productions!

notes.title: Free playable demo now available!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a free playable demo now available for all you stealthy master-tacticians to check out!
Simply click the 'Download Demo' button at the right side of the store page to download, install and play.
We hope you will enjoy this sneak peak!

[h1]UPDATE:[/h1]
The team is currently working on a Mac and Linux edition of the demo, we hope to have it ready for you soon and will certainly let you know once it arrives. :-)
